The temperature independence of Al-sapphire TBC at high temperatures suggests that the effect of inelastic phonon scattering is negligible, especially at high temperatures.
The estimated electron-phonon coupling thermal resistance within Al is about 20% of the overall thermal resistance but we did not observe clear TBC change due to this effect.
